answer: In an agent marketplace coordinating ferrous cargo at a haven’s jetty, each agent must lock a refundable bond before bidding, and its total outstanding contract value cannot exceed that bond. Splitting into a thousand identities does not increase capacity: every extra unit of work still needs the same collateral. A sybil attacker must tie up capital proportional to the business it seeks to capture, paying financing costs for as long as the bonds remain locked.
